email_subject: Application - Sales Development Representative at Khova
email_body:
Dear Khova team,

I'm applying for the Sales Development Representative role. Your focus on helping multi-location businesses make better decisions on the floor resonates with me. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and AI-driven automation, I'm eager to bring my skills to outbound sales.

In my current roles, I use AI tools daily for research, content creation, and audits, and I've built automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks. I understand how to research companies and decision-makers, craft relevant messaging, and test approaches to see what works. I'm comfortable with targets and excited to experiment across channels.

I'm fluent in English and have experience working in international teams. I'm drawn to Khova's early-stage environment where I can help build the playbook, not just follow one. I'd love to discuss how my curiosity and builder mentality can contribute to your growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Khova team,

I'm writing to apply for the Sales Development Representative position. Khova's mission to help multi-location businesses make better decisions on the floor immediately caught my attention. As someone who thrives on figuring things out and using AI to work smarter, I'm excited about the opportunity to help build your outbound motion from the ground up.

My background is in digital marketing with a technical edge. In my freelance and junior roles, I've used AI tools daily for research, content creation, and audits, and I've built Python automations to handle repetitive tasks. This experience has taught me how to quickly understand a company's needs, craft relevant messaging, and test what resonates. I've also worked with HubSpot and various SEO and analytics tools, giving me a solid foundation for sales intelligence and CRM management.

What draws me to Khova is the builder mentality. I don't need a 40-page playbook; I'm comfortable testing, learning, and iterating. I've done this in my own projects, like building and optimizing websites for search visibility, where I constantly experiment with new approaches. I'm also comfortable communicating with senior decision-makers, having worked with clients and stakeholders in previous roles.

I'm fluent in English and have experience in international teams. I'm eager to bring my curiosity, AI-savviness, and target-driven mindset to Khova. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your next stage of growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

• Fluent English and experience in international, remote teams
• Builder mentality: self-started freelance projects, launched an Android app, and continuously experiments with new approaches
